channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Beyond Embedded: How DuckDB v2.0 Shifts Architecture Toward Distributed Network Capabilities
item.description: DuckDB Labs has previewed DuckDB v2.0, codenamed "Cyanoptera." This release includes over 10000 commits and introduces a client/server mode, enabling network connections. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Nuxt 4.5: Experimental SSR Streaming, Vite 8 and an Rsbuild-Powered Rspack Builder
item.description: Nuxt has released version 4.5, featuring updates such as a switch to Vite 8, a new Rspack 2 builder, and experimental SSR streaming. This streaming enhances Time to First Byte by flushing the HTML shell instantly. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Aurora now supports PostgreSQL 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23
item.description: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition now supports PostgreSQL versions 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23 which include bug fixes from the PostgreSQL community and Aurora-specific enhancements. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Lambda functions now support full IAM resource-based policies
item.description: AWS Lambda functions now support full Identity and Access Management (IAM) resource-based policies , enabling platform admins and security teams to define granular access permissions using the full capabilities of AWS IAM. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EKS now supports multiple external OIDC identity providers per cluster
item.description: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) now supports multiple external OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity providers per cluster. (1 source: aws)

item.title: SageMaker MLflow now supports customer managed keys
item.description: SageMaker MLflow now enables customers to encrypt their data using customer-managed keys (CMK) through AWS Key Management Service (KMS). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ECS now automatically detects and repairs container instances with impaired agent connectivity
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now automatically detects and repairs container instances, enabling customers to reduce undetected workload failures and improve application availability without manual intervention. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod enhances support for Ray
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now enhances support for Ray with built-in observability, resilient training, accelerated inference and managed development environments. (1 source: aws)
